{{Quote|These heartless Imps are dumping chems, and it's killing the poor 'tauns.|Dr. Farrus Belisk|<ref name="Encounter" />}}
[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] '''Farrus Belisk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]]<ref name="Dark Heart of the Fortress" /> who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="Encounter" /> Around [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{DynamicDate|Troubled Tauns|Ilum}}</ref> Belisk raised concerns about [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operations on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]], which were leaking chemical runoff into the native [[Tauntaun/Legends|Tauntaun]] habitat.<ref name="Encounter" /> During the [[Third Galactic War]] around [[3623 BBY]],<ref name="Death" /> Belisk was sent to Ilum as part of a survey team to [[Mission to the Emperor's Fortress (Third Galactic War)|investigate]] the wreckage of [[Darth Malgus]]'s [[Emperor's Fortress|space station]]. Belisk was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the mission and his body was later reanimated as a cyberneurotic zombie by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Mind prison|mind trap]] containing the spirit of [[Darth Nul]]. The [[Alliance Commander]] and [[Lana Beniko]] killed his reanimated corpse.<ref name="Dark Heart of the Fortress" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dr. Farrus Belisk first appeared in the dynamic encounter mission "Troubled Tauns," introduced in Game Update 7.7: ''Dynamic Worlds'', released on [[May 28]], [[2025]], as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'',<ref name="Dynamic Worlds">{{TORweb|url=info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20250528-1|text=Game Update 7.7 "Dynamic Worlds" is now live!}}</ref> the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref>
